acceptedScope: Built renderer factory embeds local view/panel/source aliases and only requests React from the host
One same-origin read-only Run source, seq/generation/cancellation fencing, shared across window/card/icon presentations
Loading, refresh failure, worksite switching, invalid DTOs, out-of-order results and disposal do not publish stale Run state
Current snapshot re-resolves opaque output references; missing assets/blocks disable location and switching prevents retained old callbacks from showing old output
Real bundled panel and view produce semantic text/accessibility names with no raw runtime identity, execution/retry/fee controls or HTML interpolation
Read-only output preview remains separate from the existing editor; no new workspace write or model capability
preFreezeCorrection: Checker identified workspace refresh wait/failure retaining old Run/located output. Maker added immediate invalidation, error fence and preview hiding/clearing before freezing; focused regression passed independently.
limitations: Semantic element trees, hook/service seams and real bundle factory are programmatic integration evidence, not actual React/browser layout or human usability acceptance
Existing styles/design baseline reused; no visual rendering, screenshot or human Apple workstation experience review
No running Desktop installation or deployment, model request, provider access, profile modification or credential read
Completed remains historical successful receipt, not proof of current output presence; current snapshot resolution is required
No full-suite total, full product acceptance or expansion of frozen original protocol coverage
